ideas.title: Minnesota Officials' Involvement in Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the involvement of Minnesota officials, including Governor Tim Walz, in alleged fraud schemes.
ideas.angle: Exploring the extent of official involvement in Minnesota's fraud crisis
questions: What is the extent of official involvement?
What are the implications for Minnesota's citizens?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale corruption operation involving top officials.

ideas.title: Whistleblower Retaliation in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of whistleblower retaliation against Minnesota officials.
ideas.angle: Examining the impact of retaliation on fraud investigations
questions: What is the scope of whistleblower retaliation?
How does it affect fraud investigations?
ideas.insight: This story could expose a culture of silence and retaliation against those who speak out against fraud.
